items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: He was one of the beautiful people that was in Duke's band... Ragland and Duke had rehearsed together... we were supposed to play the United States Bond Hour

ctx.x: Did you know Junior Ragland. He was one of the beautiful people that was in Duke's band.
I'll tell you about Junior, Junior would never put on a clean shirt.
